pluginSteps.ordering: Before existing estimate locks and calculation plugins

permissions: Estimator roles: Read owned export requests; no direct Create, Update, Delete, Assign or Share.
Flow identity: Read all requests and their linked estimates; state writes only through re_EstimateExport.
Administrators alone may Create, Update or Delete re_exportconfiguration; flow/estimator roles need no configuration write.
ExportLockPlugin must reject direct outbox and reserved estimate-column writes even for administrative callers.

The main Custom API plugin has no unsecure step configuration. It reads the active unique RepairEstimator configuration record using the system service. Do not rely on its test-only constructor override for tenant configuration.
activation: Create and verify additive schema, alternate keys, restrictive relationships and optimistic concurrency.
Create exactly one active RepairEstimator configuration row with re_enabled=false, approved flow user and sample output mode.
Do not enable configuration or change live Submit until templates, scripts, both mutually exclusive flow proposals, recovery and pending UI have passed validation.
Register API and all synchronous lock steps, verify transaction context and permissions with non-admin and flow identities.
Protect generated workbooks with inherited site permissions; never grant anonymous sharing.
